args: The desktop shell can host a web tile's content in a WebContentsView — a runkitShell.web bridge group, an electron-free registry keyed (window, host, tabKey), main handlers for create/destroy/bounds/visible/load/reload, a one-channel event relay, a dedicated persist:rk-web partition with no preload, and a navigation guard that lets guests browse http(s) while the host allowlist keeps applying to hosts. Change 3d of the web-tile native browser plan; guests are siblings of the host view per the spike verdict.
